Subject: BlueBay pilot outcomes — quick ask for a 2-line quote + 15m sync

Hi Sofia / David —

Thanks again for doing this pilot with Redwood. We finished the final validation last week; attaching a short summary PDF with the numbers so you don’t have to dig through notebooks. Highlights: 
- Inference cost per generated token down ~42% vs your previous endpoint configuration (projected run-rate savings: $1.2M ARR at current volumes).
- Average p95 latency improved from ~90ms to ~30ms after batching + KV cache tweaks.
- End-to-end throughput increased ~3.6x for peak batch windows, which removed the queuing you were seeing.

Attachment: bluebay_pilot_results_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Marketing ask — we’d love a short, two-line quote from BlueBay that we can use in a one-page case note and social post, plus permission to list BlueBay Retail as a customer. Would you be open to: 1) a 2-line quote we can publish, or 2) a 15-minute call this week for Marissa on our marketing team to capture a brief soundbite?

If you prefer a call, suggested slots: Mon Oct 6, 3:00–3:30pm PT or Tue Oct 7, 10:00–10:15am PT. Happy to work around other times.

Thanks again — appreciate the partnership here.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
